description.value: Edokko Nigiri Sushi is a dine-in Japanese restaurant in Richmond's Terra Nova neighbourhood specializing in traditional Edomae-style nigiri sushi, part of the Takeya Sushi Group which has served Richmond since 2000. The kitchen is led by chefs with 10+ years of training from traditional sushi restaurants in Japan, focusing on seasonal ingredients. Reservations are accepted but highly limited, with an online waitlist system available.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 31m; stands at 63m; rack at 81m.
